title: Universal bundle map in coordinates
promptMarkdown: For the finite-cover map $J$ in the lesson, prove that $x\mapsto J_x(E_x)$ is smooth into $\mathrm{Gr}_k(\mathbb R^{mk})$. Give a local formula for the inverse of $E\to f^*\gamma_k$. Explain exactly where a finite cover is used and why a partition need not provide a single global frame of $E$.
hintLadder: Use a local frame to turn the fibre map into a matrix.
An invertible minor supplies a Grassmannian graph chart.
Use that same minor to recover the original fibre vector.
